notes.title: Today we learned about a survival game featuring Will Smith, but only because it's a massive failure
notes.content:
Last night, IGN posted a news piece about how Undawn, a free-to-play survival game starring Will Smith as some kind of apocalypse pal called Trey, has been a massive flop. Released in June 2023 for mobile and PC, Undawn had an allegedly huge budget, according to Reuters sources, but which only brought in under $300K last month, as estimated by research firm Appamgic. And on hearing this news everyone went: "Sorry, what are you talking about?"

Read more

notes.title: Guide to the Judgment Center Special Op
notes.content:
The main force of the Eagle Faction, located in the Judgment Center, will change shift at the Koller Mines in the coming days. 
The Raven Squad decided to take advantage of this opportunity to raid the base and weaken the Eagle's forces!

[b][Participation Requirements and Rewards][/b]
[b]Participation Requirements: [/b]Survivors must reach level of 65 or higher and form a team of 3-4 to enter the Judgment Center Special Op. 

[b]Tips: [/b]Survivors will face multiple challenges the Eagles are highly experienced in combat and armed with formidable weapons. Thus, it is recommended to have a combat power rating of at least 30,000 and ideally bring a team of four.

[b]Rewards:[/b] Completing the challenge will receive enhancement materials, polishing materials, and a large amount of Gold.

[b][Preparation][/b]
Checking the condition of tactical gear, medical packs, equipment durability, the effects of cooking buffs, and status of drones are all essential.
[b]
[Strategy Tutorial Stages]
Stage 1: Steady Progress[/b]
After entering the Special Op, survivors need to continuously defeat the guards along the way and advance into the base. 
The enemy force in this stage is not too high, so it is recommended for survivors to make steady progress and prioritize maintaining their health.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/de0b642fc258699cdade25abc7d7252046a3b538.png[/img]
[b]Stage 2: Rapid Bomb Disposal[/b]
After entering the second area, survivors need to disarm the bomb set by the Eagle within 100 seconds! 
The more survivors that enter the bomb disposal area, the faster the bomb can be disarmed. Survivors can use devices to fend off enemy harassment. 
Once the bomb is disarmed, two survivors can collaborate to break the gate and move on to the next area. During this period, team members can swiftly recover their health and get ready to confront the boss.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/e23b3b069afe03f3973c9fd0d5b598de4b751cfb.png[/img]
[b]Stage 3: Install Bombs and Clear Guards[/b]
Survivors need to install three bombs and clear the guards. 
Use your drones, devices, and other props to enhance your firepower.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/c0dd97dbfff5a85f08591846a3351380a71b19a2.png[/img]
[b]Stage 4: Destroy the Adjudicator Mech[/b]
The Judgment Center is heavily guarded, and the newest Adjudicator Mech is stationed there. The Adjudicator Mech can call in a large number of reinforcements and helicopters. Survivors need to make good use of the cover nearby to avoid taking damage from enemy fire. 
During the battle, the Adjudicator Mech will randomly target a team member and launch an electromagnetic pulse attack that affects all survivors. 
When the mech locks onto a team member, others should quickly destroy the energy shield to interrupt the lock from laser cannon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/51f1476322849202df8d89fa442efe84e9690cae.png[/img]

notes.title: Undawn Pre-Launch Notice
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors! 

The world of Undawn is finally here! The official server will be opened on June 15th. The detail time depends on your location.
For North America, LATAM, Australia and New Zealand survivors: [u][b]June 15th at 8:00 (UTC-5)[/b][/u]
For Japan survivors: [u][b]June 15th at 11:00 (UTC+9)[/b][/u]
For survivors from other coutries: [u][b]June 15th at 12:00 (UTC+3)[/b][/u]

Welcome to an expansive apocalyptic world where there is tons to explore and infinite possibilities to uncover.

To make the most of your experience, we recommend pre-downloading certain resources ahead of the test launch. This will allow you to download the rest of the game more quickly and start playing Undawn sooner when the test begins! During this period, you can also create your character in advance using our character customization server. Any characters created during this time will be inherited in the official service. 
Similar to the server time, the open time for character customization server will also vary based on your location.
For North America, LATAM, Australia and New Zealand survivors: [u][b]June 13 6:00 - June 14 10:00 (UTC-5)[/b][/u]
For Japan survivors: [u][b]June 14th 0:00～June 15th 0:00 (UTC+9)[/b][/u]
For survivors from other coutries: [u][b]June 13 5:00 - June 14 18:00 (UTC+3)[/b][/u]
Feel free to use your imagination and create a unique character.

In the world of Undawn, you'll get to experience a total of nine different environments, from an abandoned city to grassy plains and mines in the mountains. Be prepared to contend with all kinds of extreme conditions, such as sandstorms and acid rain, as well as weather that can turn on a dime anytime.

Keep a close eye on 12 health indicators such as Metabolism, Hygiene, Mentality, etc. If you want to survive in the apocalypse, it pays to be vigilant about the state of your body!

Danger is all around you. To survive and forge a path forward in a zombie-infested world, you must also acquaint yourself with the use of various firearms and tools.

Are you a beach lover or a fan of sublime mountainscapes? In Undawn, you can choose your favorite location and build a home of your very own, a home in which you can sleep soundly at night.

In this world, there is a multitude of unknowns, and with the unknowns come unimaginable threats. Thus, we also encourage you to seek out new friends with whom you can travel this world and tackle its many challenges together!


Join our official Discord server for the latest news about the game. You can also join us in our community events where you can meet other players and even provide your feedback to the development team!

Please feel free to get in touch with Customer Service should you encounter any issue in the game.

We look forward to seeing you in the world of Undawn!

Undawn OPS Team

notes.title: Undawn：Exposure of the Doomsday World
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/77eb76054472c674b25fd6509ad1e3d9f5b6aa68.jpg[/img]

[i](5th Street)[/i]

The world has changed.

Unknown disasters broke out and spread, and some were turned into mutants, attacking others irrationally. Disasters quickly spread, and the city turned into ruins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/7130cb03446bb9e7192db746dffb13d8dd3530c6.jpg[/img]

[i]（Abandoned Train Station）[/i]

The modern civilization of human cities has been destroyed. And all the modern heavy industry, transportation and communication were paralyzed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/477bbe5d79571600a30f63ecbedb6244afe865ec.jpg[/img]

[i]（The Lost City）[/i]

The once prosperous city has become a devastated city, and the ruined city started to turn back to nature. Human traces have long been covered by dust, and nature is decorating the entire city in its own way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/42215e872e743fa53b3db1a3f9f0bbdf80dacbf8.jpg[/img]

[i]（Blockade）[/i]

Major cities have set up isolation zones to blockade, and this is the survivors' last stronghold in the city. There are still a large number of technological equipments in the fortress with high walls, protecting survivors from all over the world. The survivors fight side by side here, hoping to build their own world behind the wall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/4f57e991c345ec7868a425f9387570ab619be7b5.jpg[/img]

[i]（Abandoned Gas Station）[/i]

The once crowded gas station is now a total mess. Under the vine-grown roof, supplies and gasoline were looted, leaving an unbreakable silence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/0214f3d436e4e0aaee2e813c60c4737989ebe62e.jpg[/img]

[i]（Ocean Bridge）[/i]

The sunset ignites the sky, looking from the abandoned gas station to the direction of the Lost City, the Ocean Bridge hidden behind the dense forest, waiting to be restored to its former glory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/040130b821865f4afe7941a450255a4a45a83967.jpg[/img]

[i]（Ravens Shelter）[/i]

A heavily guarded Ravens Shelter, with sentries on guard at all times. Under the warm sunshine, there was a rare peace in front of the shelter. People here have a common belief: Survive and rebuild their homeland.

notes.title: Undawn：Navigating the World of Undawn on CBT Day 1
notes.content:
New to the world of Undawn and overwhelmed by all the new things to explore in the wilderness?
Do you have countless questions about what's going on?

Let me give you a quick introduction as you embark on this journey!


[h3][b]Acquainting Yourself with the Wilderness![/b][/h3]


The Ravens Shelter is where survivors have gathered. The Raven Squad will provide you with essential knowledge on how to survive in the wilderness, including how to use the survival gauge to monitor your stats. They will also supply you with resources to help you establish your own homestead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/040130b821865f4afe7941a450255a4a45a83967.jpg[/img]
                       (Raven Camp)


[h3][b]Join a Camp with Free Food and Events![/b][/h3]


Exploring and surviving in a new world can be easier with a buddy (or two). Check out camp recruitment notices at the shelter entrance to find camp buddies and access a variety of camp events. Safety and security come in numbers!

You can either join an existing camp or create a new one. To create a new camp, fill out required information and send a recruitment notice. The camp is formed when at least six survivors respond. To join an existing camp, simply submit a request to one that suits you.

Once you're part of a camp, enjoy free meals at the camp dining hall between 11:30-14:00 and 17:30-20:00 each day. Pro Tip: Try to come in for meals to restore various stats and gain certain buffs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/201b620915763ab0dd70071af4bf2f3ba576dce8.png[/img]
                       (Create Camp)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/caae96427b0df57766042df56d132fbd57bb53f3.png[/img]
                       (Camp Dining Hall)


[h3][b]Take Part in Your First Team Battle at the Lost City![/b][/h3]


Join your first team battle at the Lost City by teaming up with other survivors at the Ravens Shelter to defend our home. Your mission is to search for valuable medical and military supplies left by a fallen rescue squad. You can participate in this daily Special Op multiple times, but rewards are only available for the first completion each day. The Lost City is open to teams of 3-4 players at Lv. 13 and above, with the difficulty level dynamically adjusted based on the average team level. Be prepared to encounter numerous zombies and a robot called the "Corruptor" inside the Lost City. To deal the highest possible damage output, make use of rifles, shotguns, and heavy weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/ea347843f844b32ad0c8c1daddbb2c2fe148cfe9.png[/img]
                       (Special Ops: The Lost City)


[h3][b]Experience thrilling daily events such as the Aeronautical Base![/b][/h3]


Once you have your survival essentials covered, it's time to explore the exciting activities and events that the wilderness has to offer. You'll be pleasantly surprised by what you discover! The Ravens are hosting team competitions at the Aeronautical Base to train survivors in essential survival skills. The Aeronautical Base is open to players between 12:00 and 13:00 daily. Test your combat skills by attempting to conquer the base!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/193ddc5dec3f6c50243432e76124330f7c11723c.png[/img]
                       (Ltd-time Calendar)


[h3][b]Seek Out New Buddies at the Bonfire Party[/b][/h3]


Bonfire Party, where you can unwind and enjoy a plethora of activities, including delicious food and the opportunity to make new friends. The festivities commence at 19:30 and unfold in three parts: igniting the bonfire, taking part in the Survival Quiz, and dancing around the bonfire. Activities include moving wood to light the bonfire up to three times, locating the NPC, and answering five quiz questions, and participating in three rounds of dancing with automatically assigned partners. Completing these activities will earn you rewards in the form of Camp Contribution and Silver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/5541a87b000d2dc37e0bbeb8078c06cbea451208.png[/img]
                       (Bonfire Party Ticket）

Great! These are the essential things you need to know to embark on your journey in the world of Undawn. Shall we join hands and move towards the light of dawn together?

notes.title: Undawn：How Do Survivors Thrive in A World Full of Danger？ 100 Ways to Survive
notes.content:
In a post-apocalyptic world, [b]a healthy lifestyle[/b] is the key to survival.

How do survivors thrive in a world full of danger and uncertainty? We need to understand the most basic survival system in UNDAWN.

When entering the Raven Shelter, we will receive a [b]Survival Health Monitor[/b] from [b]Dr. Michael[/b], which can intuitively display the status of our [b]BODY, MENTALITY, HYGIENE, and METABOLISM[/b] metrics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/cf0033bb8ffdfef5f3750338e1fcabda562c42fa.jpg[/img]
                           (Health Monitor)

[h3][u][b]BODY[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/7b184ea739042703f459e235ae3882665e597c38.jpg[/img]

The most ideal body type is Average!  Being too lean or bulky will have some impact to your status. To achieve an Average body, exercise is the way to go.

[h3][u][b]MENTALITY[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/904c735c5db1e1e32cb63e6a9aa874e6f07549e5.jpg[/img]

Mentality metrics is divided into three states: Exhausted, Tired, and Awake, which affects the survivor's gathering speed. To alleviate fatigue and tiredness, simply getting a good night's sleep will solve the problem.

[h3][u][b]HYGIENE[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/5fc52f43088470a0f8cae867c72d79ef3ad0281d.jpg[/img]

Dirty skin or clothing can easily attract attacks from zombies!

To stay clean, just wash in a clean water source.


[h3][u][b]METABOLISM[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/5cfaddfa18ba4af2815f73489aab5fdd25f546db.jpg[/img]

When the bladder and stomach reach a certain volume, the body will feel uncomfortable. Remember to metabolize in time.


Wait...

There are three more survival metrics that were almost forgotten to introduce!

They are [b]Hydration, Hunger[/b] and [b]Health.[/b]

Dehydration will increase the rate of energy consumption and can lead to death  in severe cases. To avoid this, simply [b]drink water[/b] on time.

If you're feeling hungry, your gathering speed will getting slow. So feed yourself before starving!

Low health will increase damage you receive, but it can be improved by using antibody drugs. In addition to bandages and First Aid Kit, some foods can also restore a moderate amount of health!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/59be7bfb35bd331c28c130fbd0d8121585cb73d4.jpg[/img]

________________

<100 Ways to Survive in Doomsday>：A series of columns about how to survive in the doomsday world. In undawn, you will experience the most realistic exploration and cooperative survival in the doomsday world.

notes.title: Undawn: the Past and Present of the Apocalypse
notes.content:
[h3]Undawn, an immersive open-world survival game. Are you ready to embark on the daring adventures?[/h3]


[h2][u][b]Federal Year 164[/b][/u][/h2]


A scientific exploration team discover an unknown element in the mysterious volcano remains on [b]Aurich Island[/b].

The government soon blocked the island and started to conduct confidential millitary researches.

In the new century, VENUS scientists utilized this element to make a breakthrough on material technologies like artificial neural network, artificial conduction and interstitial fluid. Biomimetics, biology and gene therapy had made huge progress based on these technologies.

However, the energy brought by this element went far off beyond expectation. Things were turing sideways...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/b400e19a855c974b9aa7457445afcc457482bf05.jpg[/img]
 (Aurich Island forest)


[h2][u][b]Federal Year 258[/b][/u][/h2]


[h3]1.	Outbrek[/h3]

The catastrophe suddenly broke out in the capital of west coast state Mercer.

A few humankinds were turned into mutants, and attacked others irrationally.

Astral Tower, the headquarter of VENUS was the first location that flooded by the mutants.

Lots of mutants were wandering on the street. People were devoured before knowing what is going on.
Cities were detroyed and turned into ruins due to the spread of the mutation. The once flourishing coastal city soon turn into the devastated Lost City.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/55fbbf3a343218f0f21bf4fda7af45a0a4215599.png[/img]
   (Blockade area of Lost City)

All major cities started to set up blockade area and urban modern civilization was fully destroyed. All the modern heavy industry, transportation and communication were paralyzed.

The ruins of the city turned back into nature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/f6c0e88a7976c3e5fb42a2c62a5d5a35636143a5.png[/img]
                                                  (Urban Forest)

[h3]2.	Flee from disaster[/h3]

The blockade did not stop the virus, the catastrophy soon spread to other federal states. The horrible mutants flooded and wiped out everything.

The urban civilization of the west continent was destroyed. Some survivors managed to escape from the cities.

They fell from towns and exiled in the wild. They went on the trip to survive in desperation, and looking for a chance to survive in the wildness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/95a67013d4673e7dbef6cffe2cddd4da20d42474.jpg[/img]
(Bridge of Lost City)

[h3]3.	Rebirth[/h3]

The survivors escaped from Lost City managed to survive from the crucial winter.
With the guiding of Raven Rescue Squad, they were able to build a simple shelter in the wildness of Seinz Hills and fight for their lives with countless of mutants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/bfd5483ff79eca3c3c497960985bb8c7f596a0ca.jpg[/img]
(Seinz Hills Bridge)

Rusty abandoned vehicles were stacked on the side of the roads, which made it more desolate.
Barbed wire and roadblock were everywhere. They seemed to be used to defend from something.
There got to be lots of supplies with all these fortifications.         

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/7e30571d344ff72769a50948ead5b56b1bbebc12.png[/img]
 (Mansion)

[h3]4.	Evolution[/h3]

Mutants were still invading different regions as time pasts. In the abandon area, new evolution were secretly taken place.

A new crisis were coming, and the truth were wrapped in mist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858799/77eb76054472c674b25fd6509ad1e3d9f5b6aa68.jpg[/img]
（5th Street）


[h2][u][b]Federal Year 262[/b][/u][/h2]


Maybe one day, the dawn will come and and everything is coming back to life.

Diversified survival situations, a more than ever survival game experience and excellent shooting controls that differs from tradition shooting games.

[b]We are hoping to find more survival game fans from all over the world to experience and explore the mystery open world together!
[/b]
